div.div: وَشْوَاشٌ Light, active, or agile; (Lth, S, K;) applied to a man; (S;) and to an ostrich; (AA, K;) and so ↓ وَشْوَاشَةٌ applied to a she-camel; (K;) or this last, so applied, signifies quick, and light or active or agile; and so وَشْوَاشٌ applied to a he-camel; and ↓ وَشْوَشٌ applied to a he-camel and to a man. (TA.) You say also, الذِّرَاعِ ↓ رَجُلٌ وَشْوَشِىُّ , meaning, نشَنَشِييُّهُ, (K,) i. e., A man slender in the [fore] arm, and light, or active, in work. (AO, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
